title: Full graph matching trace
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $r>0$, and let $M$ be a perfect matching of the complete $2r$-partite graph whose parts each have $k$ vertices. The entire vertex set admits a pairing trace of length $rk$, in which each step chooses a pivot in a largest remaining part and a partner from a different part, and deletes both vertices.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a perfect matching of the complete $2r$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part
